name: Test Chip
text: A frozen test fixture chip covering every generic loadout-param hook.

nodes.name: Test Conditional Stats
nodes.text: +2 attack vs an afflicted opponent; +1 armor while you have no status.

nodes.name: Test Integrity Damage
nodes.text: +2 graft damage dealt, -1 graft damage taken.

nodes.name: Test Status Duration
nodes.text: Bleed/Numb/Fever/Necrosis you inflict last 1 round longer.

nodes.name: Test Kill Trigger
nodes.text: Heal 2 and deal 1 Strain to the opponent whenever you destroy one of their grafts.

nodes.name: Test Cleanse
nodes.text: Purging heals 2 and vents 1; your grafts regenerate 1 integrity each round; your World Faction cards cost 1 less.
